info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Collateral Administration By Param1-spec
info.description: The Collateral Asset Administration Update API allows users to modify specific details related to collateral assets based on provided parameters. This endpoint is essential for financial institutions that require timely adjustments to collateral management, ensuring compliance and risk mitigation. Typical consumers include banking and finance sectors looking to manage their collateral assets more effectively. The API enables operations such as updating asset details to reflect current valuations or changes in ownership, enhancing data accuracy for decision-making.

patch.description: This operation allows users to modify existing collateral asset administration resources identified by their unique resource ID. The updated data will be processed and persisted in the system, ensuring accurate asset information.
